description.value: Days Inn by Wyndham Vernon is a national chain hotel located on 26 Street in Vernon, BC, in the heart of the Okanagan — a popular hub for cycling routes including the Okanagan Rail Trail. As a full-service chain property it offers the predictability and accessibility that touring cyclists value when covering long distances through the region.
